title: Corruption after exiting external editors in terminalBuffer mode

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly reports terminal screen corruption upon exiting an external editor while in terminalBuffer mode and identifies the technical need to force a full screen refresh on the Ink side.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The issue requires a localized fix in packages/cli/src/ui/AppContainer.tsx by updating handleEditorClose to call app.rerender() when terminalBuffer mode (config.getUseTerminalBuffer()) is enabled.

summary.problem: Terminal screen corruption occurs after exiting an external editor when operating in terminalBuffer mode.
summary.root_cause: In packages/cli/src/ui/AppContainer.tsx, handleEditorClose handles CoreEvent.ExternalEditorClosed but only calls app.rerender() when shouldUseAlternateScreen is true. In terminalBuffer mode (config.getUseTerminalBuffer()), shouldUseAlternateScreen is false and refreshStatic() does nothing, leaving Ink without a trigger to perform a full screen refresh after returning from the external editor.
summary.context: External editors take over terminal standard I/O and leave raw screen artifacts upon closing. Ink needs to re-render the view buffer when the editor closes.

steps: Update handleEditorClose to call app.rerender() when config.getUseTerminalBuffer() returns true.
Ensure config is added to the useCallback dependency array for handleEditorClose.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When CoreEvent.ExternalEditorClosed fires while running in terminalBuffer mode, Ink's app.rerender() is invoked to refresh the screen.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in packages/cli/src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx where config.getUseTerminalBuffer() is mocked to return true.
Emit CoreEvent.ExternalEditorClosed and assert that app.rerender() was called.
